text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Did you... lend us a helping hand...?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
............I see. You're really counting 
on me, aren't you? In that case――

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I'll blow those expectations right outta 
the water! Just you wait and see!
